summary: Sealed bush-edged parking apron beside a small utility building, no homes nearby.
reasons: Sealed apron with several parked cars

drivers.seclusion: Dense bush to the north and east, reservoir and open grass to the south; no homes in view.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed road reaches a wide apron with several cars; room for a van well off the lane.
drivers.traffic: Quiet internal road; a through road runs about 60 m north through the bush.
drivers.convention: Cars already park on the apron, so a van would not stand out.

flags: Gates mapped nearby but each has a way round
Reservoir site may be managed; signs not visible
sun_shade: Mostly shaded by tall trees to the north and east; open to the south.

best_section.where: Sealed apron at the ring, east of the junction beside the small square building
